Local Painting Services
Your Expert House Painters

EA Pro Painters is proud to provide exceptional interior and exterior painting services in the greater Eastside area of King County, including Bellevue, Kirkland, Redmond, Issaquah and Bothell. Our professional painters have decades of experience and take pride in producing outstanding results. Do you need to find a painting contractor that warranties their work? We provide a full range of painting services including staining, painting, wallpapering, and more.

About
EA PRO PAINTERS

EA Pro Painters is a professional painting company in Bellevue, WA on the Eastside of the greater Seattle area. Our main areas we service are the cities of Bellevue, Redmond, Issaquah, Woodinville, Sammamish, Duvall, Bothell, Factoria and Kirkland.
